definitions: The practice of encouraging customers to buy a more expensive or upgraded version of a product or service, or to purchase additional items, in order to increase the value of the sale.
The act of persuading a customer to buy something extra or more expensive when they are already making a purchase.
examples: The company focuses on upselling premium features to existing subscribers.
Effective upselling can significantly boost revenue.
They are upselling the extended warranty with every new appliance.
